context:
Tiny tooling addition. Reuse the generate_indexes.py pattern; the only real
decisions are the module list (from the parent) and the LOC-counting rule
(from the existing manual table). Add a --check mode so CI enforces freshness.
description:
Promoted from the deferred item in
[[uat-config-schema-spec-realignment]] (surfaced by the UAT-effort
assessment, 2026-07-16). The UAT spec carries a module/LOC table that is
maintained by a dated manual re-measure. That table drifts silently between
re-measures, and the realignment item chose a manual re-measure as
sufficient-for-now ("Tooling nicety; a dated manual re-measure with the
realignment is sufficient and the table drifts slowly.").

This item makes the table generated instead of hand-maintained: a small
script measures the LOC of the named UAT modules from the tree and either
emits the table or checks it in CI, so the number stops drifting.

Gated on the realignment item because that item establishes the authoritative
module list and the table's current shape; auto-generating a table whose rows
are about to be re-scoped would be wasted work.

anti_patterns.dont: redefine which modules or which lines count
anti_patterns.why: reproduce the parent's table definition, or the generated numbers will disagree with the spec's intent.

deferrals.reason: Only the UAT spec module/LOC table is in scope; a general docs-count framework is a separate effort.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: Generalizing the LOC-table generator to unspecified 'other doc count-tables' is premature/vague before the single UAT-spec instance proves out.
deferrals.summary: Generalise the generator to other doc count-tables

preserves.behavior: The generated table matches the realignment item's module definitions and LOC-counting rules exactly (no silent redefinition of what counts).

prior_art.concept: The repo rule (PR template Public Contract Check) that platform/benchmark count claims in docs must be generated/checked from metadata, not editorial — this table should follow the same discipline.
_project/scripts/generate_indexes.py — existing generator style/CLI conventions to match for the new LOC-table generator.
uat-config-schema-spec-realignment — establishes the authoritative module list this generator measures; consume it, do not re-derive the list.

verifications.description: Generator reproduces the spec table and --check fails on drift
verifications.expected: check passes against the committed table; a deliberate edit makes it fail

work_units.evidence: Pinned the module list + bucket mapping + LOC rule from the manual spec table (26 modules under tests/uat/, 9 buckets, raw wc -l). Confirmed the committed actual-LOC column is already stale post-#1251/#1257 (charter-drift #1252 set pre-#1251 values), demonstrating the need for autogen.
work_units.notes:
Confirm uat-config-schema-spec-realignment landed and read the resulting
module/LOC table: which modules are rows, how LOC is counted (with/without
tests, blanks, comments). The generator must reproduce that definition.
work_units.summary: Re-validate the manual table exists post-realignment and pin its module list

work_units.evidence: _project/scripts/uat_loc_table.py: reads the spec, updates each module row's Actual column from wc -l (preserving Responsibility/est, robust to pipes via second-to-last cell), and regenerates a per-bucket+total summary between UAT-LOC-SUMMARY markers from a pinned module->bucket map (reproduces, does not redefine, the manual table's module set + wc -l rule). --check diffs generated vs committed (exit 1 on drift, proven: a tweaked Actual -> exit 1); default rewrites. ruff+ty clean.
work_units.notes:
Small script (align with existing _project/scripts conventions and the
generate_indexes.py style) that measures the pinned modules and renders
the spec table, plus a --check mode for CI that fails on drift. Follow the
repo rule that count claims in docs are generated/checked, not editorial.

work_units.evidence: Wired --check into .github/workflows/lint.yml (hashFiles-guarded, beside timing_policy) + .pre-commit-config.yaml (id: uat-loc-table, pass_filenames:false, files: tests/uat/*.py|the spec|the generator). Replaced the hand-maintained per-bucket numbers in the spec with the generated marker block + a note that the Actual column and buckets are autogen; removed stale landing-size LOCs. Generator regenerated the table to current develop (total 10,216). --check green.
work_units.notes:
Replace the hand-maintained table with generated output and add the
--check invocation to the appropriate lint/pre-commit path so it cannot
drift again.
work_units.summary: Wire the check into the spec/CI and replace the manual table
